notes: Source: Dallas Fed staff profile publication list (homepage shows no papers; no CV). The profile gives only coauthor names, not bylines, so author order is a best guess: coauthors alphabetically with the scholar included at its alphabetical position for some items, scholar-first for others; order not verified. Dallas Fed WP years use latest revision (2505/2506 revised 2026 -> 2026; 2503 revised Oct 2026 -> 2026; 2209 revised Nov 2024 -> 2024). Undated items on the profile: 'Effects of Wildfires on Credit Markets' 2022, 'Gender and Collaboration in the Federal Reserve System' 2022, 'The Real Consequences of LTV Limits on Housing Choices' 2020 (years as shown on profile). 'Determinants of Fiscal and Monetary Policies During the Covid-19 Crisis' is shown with NBER WP number 24761 on the profile (number may be a typo). WP 2209 has a new author set after the Nov 2024 revision.
